newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Abidjan stock market up on week.
newsitem.headline: Abidjan stock market up on week.

text.p: The Abidjan stock market continued to rise this week and the all-share index, the BVA, has now risen by over a third since the start of the year, the stock exchange said on Friday.
The BVA closed at 482.32, up 1.98 percent compared with last week and 34.8 percent compared with the end of 1996.

Among the gains, food and agriculture company Blohorn rose 1,700 CFA francs to 50,000 and bank SGBCI added 2,600 to 28,110. But the most active share was tobacco company SITAB, which fell 1,500 CFA francs to 60,000 on turnover of 103.9 million CFA francs -- 11 percent of all turnover for the week.
The stock exchange said turnover totalled 919.4 million CFA francs and 33,762, shares were traded, double the amount recorded last week.
